processes.description:
Pipeline: Client: Jack Riggs
Niche: Toyota New and Used car dealer
Primary offer: Book a call to see if we have your car in stock!
Target audience: People who need cars, or recently crashed their cars, or people looking to buy a fleet of vehicles for their company. 
Service area or geography: The bay area
Primary business goal: Sell cars
Priority platforms: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X / Twitter, Threads, Snapchat, Reddit
Specific research and execution notes: I want to see the best plan for selling cars and generating leads on people who want to come buy a car. It’s important they trust us as an advisor, rather then think of us as salesmen.
